title: Inventory Search
description: This mod adds a command and an item that can search players inventories for items.
body:
This mod adds the /search command and the Inventory Searcher.                                     

/search <self> <item>                                                                              
/search <entity> <name> <item>                                                                                                                                                                 
The search command is used to search an inventory for the specified item and returns all indexes that contain that item including the amount of that item.                                 
     
The Inventory Searcher is used to search other peoples inventories for the item placed in the gui.                                                                                            
Right Click to open the GUI and place the item you want to find inside the slot.                                                                      
Punch an entity with the Inventory Searcher to search that entity.
